description: CallRail call logs, newest first (default 7 days): caller, source, duration, outcome, recording. FirmOps does not place or answer calls. Outcome: answered, voicemail, or missed. Read-only. Sign-in required.

limit.description: Calls per page, newest first, 1-100. Defaults to 25.

page.description: Page number from total_pages. Defaults to 1.

search.description: Caller name or phone number to match.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days before end_date.

status.description: answered: a person picked up. voicemail: went to voicemail. missed: not answered and no voicemail (rang out or hung up).

tracker.description: Tracking number (source) name text, e.g. "Google Ads", or a tracker id (TRK...).

name: list_calls
title: List CallRail call logs
